formal_name: Phase 5.6B R6 Transactional Publication-Failure Repair Authority Maintenance R7

blockers: old payload was deleted before mandatory publication completed
exact prior payload therefore could not be restored
ARP, uninstaller, and Start Menu cleanup outcomes were not aggregated and verified
partial ARP publication could satisfy a minimal presence check
cleanup override lacked structured initiating-failure context
branch-sensitive tests require a governed ownership SHA refresh

transaction.commit_rule: TransactionCommitted becomes true only after the activated canonical payload and every mandatory publication surface independently verify successfully.

payload_preservation.transaction_root: the versioned payload is {app}\app; do not rename the whole {app} root because canonical unins000.* publication occupies that root
payload_preservation.existing_payload: rename the exact canonical {app}\app payload to the collision-safe operation-specific preserved-old path before activating staged bytes
payload_preservation.preserved_identity: record path, existence, file inventory, sizes and SHA-256 values before activation
payload_preservation.clean_install: record prior_payload_present=false; no restoration source exists or is implied
payload_preservation.upgrade: record prior_payload_present=true; restoration must reproduce the recorded preserved identity

prior_surface_snapshot.timing: before activation or any new mandatory-surface publication
prior_surface_snapshot.lifetime: success branch: retain through transaction commit; failure branch: retain through completed restoration verification and evidence sealing
prior_surface_snapshot.presence_flags: record prior-present independently for ARP, each uninstaller file, and Start Menu shortcut
prior_surface_snapshot.arp: record exact governed values DisplayName, DisplayVersion, InstallLocation, DisplayIcon and UninstallString plus key presence and DACL/SDDL needed for exact restoration
prior_surface_snapshot.uninstaller: snapshot and inventory exactly {app}\unins000.exe, {app}\unins000.dat and {app}\unins000.msg individually with presence, size and SHA-256
prior_surface_snapshot.start_menu: copy the exact prior {userprograms}\Pastila Scout.lnk to collision-safe evidence/preservation storage and record file size/SHA-256 plus resolved target, arguments and working directory
prior_surface_snapshot.ambiguity: missing identity, failed snapshot, unexpected companion, or unreadable prior surface fails closed before mutation
prior_surface_snapshot.disposal_policy: success branch: remove preserved payload and snapshots only after commit; failure branch: after restoration verification and evidence seal, remove and verify only snapshot/residue artifacts while proving restored authority state remains untouched

restoration.trigger: any mandatory publication operation or verification failure before commit
steps: retire or remove the failed newly activated payload
remove and verify absence of failed-new partial mandatory surfaces
restore the preserved old payload when prior_payload_present=true
restore every prior mandatory surface from its pre-publication snapshot according to its independent prior-present flag
reread and compare canonical payload and every restored or required-absent surface to the recorded identities and presence flags
record restoration and cleanup results independently
retain snapshots through evidence sealing after failure, then remove and verify only transaction snapshots/residue without touching restored authority state
restoration.clean_install_final_state: no canonical installed payload, ARP record, uninstaller, mandatory Start Menu shortcut, stage, old, or rollback residue
restoration.upgrade_final_state: byte-exact prior canonical {app}\app payload and every prior mandatory surface restored and independently matched to its recorded identity; no failed-new surface or transaction residue
restoration.restoration_failure: cleanup_failure / cleanup / custom code 9 with structured initiating_failure

verification.DisplayVersion: exact candidate AppVersion and valid stable SemVer

mandatory_surfaces.cleanup: delete governed key, check operation result, then prove key and governed values absent

mandatory_surfaces.verification: all three exact canonical files exist and ARP UninstallString resolves exactly to unins000.exe; no stale-old path or unenumerated companion is accepted
mandatory_surfaces.cleanup: delete each of the three enumerated files, check every return value, then prove each exact path absent

mandatory_surfaces.verification: exact path; target {app}\app\PastilaScout.exe; no arguments; working directory {app}; no stale target accepted
mandatory_surfaces.cleanup: delete exact shortcut, check return value, then prove exact path absent

mandatory_surfaces.reason: governed optional unchecked task; not part of aggregate mandatory-publication success

aggregate_publication.pass_rule: every mandatory surface operation succeeds and every exact post-publication verification passes
aggregate_publication.fail_rule: one failed, partial, stale, missing, inaccessible, or ambiguous surface fails the aggregate

order: remove and verify absence of failed-new partial surfaces
restore prior unins000.exe, unins000.dat and unins000.msg according to recorded presence flags
restore prior HKCU64 ARP governed values according to recorded key presence, verify values, then apply the recorded DACL/SDDL last and verify security state
restore prior Start Menu shortcut artifact according to its recorded presence flag
independently compare all restored files, values, paths, shortcut properties and security identity to snapshots
prior_surface_restoration.absent_before: if a prior-present flag is false, the corresponding surface must be absent after rollback
prior_surface_restoration.failure: any removal, restoration, reread, identity mismatch, or ambiguous state produces cleanup_failure / cleanup / 9 with exact initiating_failure context

items: partial HKCU64 ARP key and governed values
partial or failed-new canonical uninstaller files
stage, old and rollback transaction residue
per_item_contract: do not ignore return or exit status
compare with required absence or restored-state identity
verified_aggregate_cleanup.aggregate_pass: cleanup_success only when every applicable operation and verification passes
verified_aggregate_cleanup.aggregate_fail: any failed or ambiguous applicable item produces cleanup_failure / cleanup / 9

failure_precedence.condition: publication fails; restoration and aggregate cleanup succeed
failure_precedence.initiating_failure: omitted because final fields already represent the cause

failure_precedence.condition: publication fails; restoration or aggregate cleanup fails

initiating_failure_schema.required_when: cleanup_failure overrides an initiating R6 publication failure
initiating_failure_schema.omitted_when: not applicable or the final fields already express the publication failure
initiating_failure_schema.validation: all three members required and exact when object is present; arbitrary strings/codes rejected
initiating_failure_schema.backward_compatibility: historical records without the optional field remain valid and are not rewritten; every strict consumer must receive a schema/validator upgrade before consuming R7 records, and safe ignoring of unknown fields is not assumed

terminology.restoration_or_rollback: restore authoritative payload state after transaction failure
terminology.general_cleanup_failure: failure of any required cleanup or restoration action governed by code 9

vm06.restoration: exact prior payload if present; otherwise no canonical installed payload
vm06.failed_cleanup_result: cleanup_failure / cleanup / 9 plus exact initiating_failure object

custom_exit_precedence: surface publication failure with successful cleanup is 11
other existing earlier failure mappings remain unchanged

required_process: compute final test size, lines, SHA-256 and Git blob
create and formally freeze a new ownership refresh record
only then allow governed fresh Release preparation to consume the new test identity

future_test_authority: upgrade publication failure with exact old-payload restoration
unchanged activation and unrelated cleanup failure

consumer_impact.installer_state_machine: defer old-payload deletion until transaction commit and implement restoration
consumer_impact.result_writer_and_exit_logic: emit R6 mapping and optional exact initiating_failure object
consumer_impact.result_validator_and_evidence_parsers: strictly validate/preserve the optional nested object
consumer_impact.operational_acceptance_and_matrix_valida: enforce aggregate publication, cleanup and restoration evidence
consumer_impact.installer_tests: implement branch-sensitive R7 test authority under ownership refresh
consumer_impact.ownership_authority: freeze final refreshed test identity before build authority
consumer_impact.preparation_DAG_and_provenance: reground after implementation and ownership freeze
consumer_impact.fresh_release: consume only final candidate and refreshed ownership identities

lifecycle.closed_VM01_THROUGH_VM05: NOT_REOPENED_BY_R7; future implementation requires separate impact analysis

false_positive_rejections: activation completion treated as transaction commit
old payload deleted before all surface verification
ignored cleanup return or exit status
